children: Quantum X Labs appointed former Mossad Director Yossi Cohen as President of its Scientific Advisory Board to guide commercialization and defense-focused applications of its quantum technologies.
Yossi Cohen, Mossad Director (2016–2021) and former National Security Advisor, named President of the Scientific Advisory Board.
Cohen will help shape QXL’s roadmap across quantum computing, error correction, sensing, cybersecurity and precision timing.
Appointment aims to accelerate commercialization and defense, aerospace, homeland security and critical infrastructure applications.
Cohen’s roles with SoftBank (leading Israel activities for Vision Fund 2; strategic advisor Aug 2026) expected to strengthen investor and infrastructure ties.
